goal: Review only the printable UDS bench mount geometry; populated assembly and real Nucleo fit are separate gates.

attempts.title: Attempt 01

findings: One continuous printable base occupies the entire image; no separate loose parts are present.
The long Nucleo cradle occupies the left two thirds; the 60 x 40 mm carrier pattern occupies the right third of the 222 x 90 mm plate.
Four carrier bosses, two tie slots, four catches, and four corner end stops are visible in the top and isometric views.
Every rail, boss and catch connects to the base or its supporting rail; no floating material is visible.
The catches sit above the rail support surfaces and the four bored bosses stand on the base; board fit is a separate physical check.
The plate lies on XY with rail and boss features upward along +Z; the open connector ends align with the long axis of the cradle.
The same four boss bores and two tie slots appear in both top and isometric views without changed dimensions or detached features.
